create_CohereAsrConfig: create a CohereAsrConfig instance for the Cohere ASR encoder-decoder model with default settings
configure_encoder_parakeet: configure the ParakeetEncoderConfig sub-config with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention_heads
initialize_head_dim: initialize head_dim automatically from hidden_size divided by num_attention_heads when not explicitly set
setup_kv_heads: set num_key_value_heads to match num_attention_heads when not explicitly provided
load_encoder_from_dict: load the encoder config from a dictionary by merging with default ParakeetEncoderConfig parameters
